arguments.sql:
SELECT
    pl.picklist_id,
    pl.line_no,
    pl.product_id,
    pl.location_id,
    pl.qty,
    lg.activity,
    lg.log_time,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.inventory AS i
     WHERE i.location_id = pl.location_id AND i.product_id = pl.product_id) AS matching_inventory_rows,
    (SELECT MIN(pu.purchased)
     FROM main.inventory AS i
     JOIN main.purchases AS pu ON pu.id = i.purchase_id
     WHERE i.location_id = pl.location_id AND i.product_id = pl.product_id) AS earliest_matching_purchase
FROM main.picking_line AS pl
LEFT JOIN main.picking_log AS lg
    ON lg.picklist_id = pl.picklist_id AND lg.pickline_no = pl.line_no
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
ORDER BY pl.picklist_id, pl.line_no, lg.log_time

WITH picked AS (
    SELECT product_id, location_id, SUM(qty) AS line_qty
    FROM main.picking_line
    WHERE order_id = 421
    GROUP BY product_id, location_id
)
SELECT i.product_id, pu.purchased, pu.id AS purchase_id,
       COUNT(*) AS location_rows, SUM(i.qty) AS inventory_qty,
       COUNT(picked.location_id) AS matching_pick_locations,
       SUM(picked.line_qty) AS matching_pick_qty
FROM main.inventory AS i
JOIN main.purchases AS pu ON pu.id = i.purchase_id
LEFT JOIN picked ON picked.product_id = i.product_id AND picked.location_id = i.location_id
WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM picked)
GROUP BY i.product_id, pu.purchased, pu.id
ORDER BY i.product_id, pu.purchased, pu.id

FROM main.picking_line AS pl

WHERE pl.order_id = 421
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id
LIMIT 1000
